data.title: Elon Musk Wants To Build 20,000 Optimus Robots A Week. There's Just One Problem, Tesla Still Can't Get The Hands To Work
data.description: Tesla is racing toward a production goal that sounds like science fiction, but a single component smaller than your palm is quietly derailing the entire timeline. The gap between Elon Musk's ambitions and what the factory floor can actually deliver has never been wider.
data.author: AJ Tiarsmith
